sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Pradosia cuatrecasasii is a large, buttressed tree known from wet lowland forests of Colombia’s Chocó region. Its leathery leaves measure about 20–40 × 8–14 cm and have a densely brown-hairy underside.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The greenish flowers are about 7.5 mm long. Smooth, ellipsoid green-brown fruits measure about 5.5–6.5 cm.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: A taxonomic monograph describes the inner bark as sweet-tasting but does not establish an edible use; it is not presented as food here.
